description: 22-byte discovery announcement (manufacturer data 0xFFFF in the scan response): stable version 2, rotating version 5, window offer version 8; dual-listening hint; title pages (v3), name pages (v7), reach pages (v4/v6) and relay SETUP; advertising payload budgets. 22-byte announcement (DiscoveryAnnouncementCodec): version(1) | node prefix or RDI(6) | flags(1) | capabilitySummary(1) | streamToken(4, BE) | routeCost(1) | [sequence(1) | width(2) | height(2) | fps(1)] or [recovery-from prefix(6) when flags&0x80] | bitrateKbps(2). Versions: 2 fixed prefix, 5 rotating discovery ID, 8 window offer (decoded only with acceptWindow). announcement flags: 0x01 accepting connections, 0x02 relay capable, 0x04 stream available, 0x08 GATT transport, 0x10 Classic transport, 0x20 stream paused, 0x40 private call available, 0x80 route recovery. capabilitySummary: bit0 VP9, bit1 AV1, bit2 reserved H.264, bit3 dual-listening hint, bit4 relayed-call consent. Integers named *_hex are big-endian lowercase hex.
